prediction: SAME-DEVICE A/B, two 420 s perflog MAX soaks on the survey route, one per arm, window 255-411 s. A is 3b5c577e9c (master 09fdca3ba1 plus PR #512's perflog-only txw[] probe on pgraph_vk_bind_textures). B is 73a4126325: A with the flush_all_frames in create_texture's surface-to-texture rebind moved from ahead of can_direct_bind into the copy branch, so a direct bind no longer drains the frames in flight. The probe is the same in both arms, so faf/bs/cp read the same counters. Judge: python3 docs/lanes/slowdown462/txwwin.py <result dir> 255 411 on each arm; gfps from the same logcat; the route's play shots in the window by eye; the cooling devices (thermal-pause, #507) read in both arms before a low or alternating fps is trusted. No Blinx txw[] split exists yet (lane.slowdown462's request 0-0-x-1790549006-slowdown462-1787985 is pending), so A is also the premise. Level play had Sub 0.1 and no staged downloads (slowdown462 NOTES, Blinx), so whether Blinx rebinds surfaces as textures at all is what P0 asks first.

legs.M0 (instrument): >= 10 txw lines in 255-411 s in each arm, all parse, flips > 0, and the play shots show level play in both. Otherwise that arm is VOID, not a zero.
legs.M1 (thermal): no thermal-pause of cpu3-7 in the window in either arm (#507). A paused arm is VOID for the fps legs P1/P2; F1 and F2 still read.
legs.F2 (no corruption; the falsifier): B's play shots show no stale, torn or black textured quads that A's do not, and B's logcat has no validation error, device-lost or crash. FAILS in the world where an in-flight frame still read the texture node through a descriptor the drain was protecting, or the zeta layout transition raced a prior copy's read; then the move is wrong and the condition must be narrowed, not dropped.
legs.P0 (premise, measured in A): A's bs >= 0.1 calls/flip and A's faf >= 0.05 calls/flip. If not, the lever does not reach Blinx's level play: F1 and P1 are read, P2 is labelled INERT (not refuted), and the arm is a control.
legs.F1 (the mover): B's faf <= 0.02 calls/flip plus A's faf share not ahead of a direct bind (A's cp calls/flip bounds that share), and B's bs within 25% of A's.
legs.P1 (fps, not worse): B's gfps median in the window >= A's minus 0.5.
legs.P2 (fps, bounded): if P0 holds: B's gfps <= 1000 / (A's ms/flip - A's faf ms/flip) + 0.5.
